Unit tests for fd_pool_para construction, accessors, conversion, locking, and concurrent acquire/release.

# Purpose
This file is a unit test for the `mypool` pool API generated by `fd_pool_para.c`. It defines a simple element type, configures the pool generator with `POOL_NAME`, `POOL_ELE_T`, `POOL_IDX_T`, and related macros, and then checks the full pool interface. The test verifies compile-time error codes, alignment and footprint rules, creation and destruction, join and leave operations, index and element conversion helpers, lock state, reset behavior, peek behavior, and error handling for invalid inputs.

The file also tests concurrent use of the pool across multiple tiles. The [`tile_main`](<#tile_main>) function runs random acquire and release operations from several threads, checks that acquired elements are valid and not duplicated within a tile, and confirms correct error returns when the pool is empty or when release is invalid. The [`main`](<#main>) function sets up shared memory, creates the pool, runs the single-tile and multi-tile tests, and then destroys the pool and checks that invalid use after deletion fails as expected.
